text: Asian Chemicals Limited as company with manufacturing facilities in a Chemical Zone (identified by Central Pollution Control Board), has recently received a notice from the State Pollution Control Board (PCB). The Board noted that the company is discharging high volume of chemicals in the water bodies which could be detrimental to the ecosystem. The notice restricts the volume of effluent discharge that can be made on account of production of chemicals. The company also recently received a large export order for supply of chemicals. The Senior Management is now concerned as to how the said order can be executed without compromising the compliance levels as required by the PCB. The Management is keen to seek your advice as to how the issue can be addressed with a Short Term and Long Term perspective through application of Sustainable Business Practices. Provide your assessment of the situation, recommendation and steps that the company can adopt to meet this challenge. Support your recommendations with suitable examples and illustrations.
